_comment: T1 The Dry fauna as designed on the Bestiary Grid (user, 2026-09-06): four per district on the dry interior floors, plus four 'open water' creatures that live at the water surface between towers. Design source for tools/build_fauna.py. hp/damage/speed are literal.

industrial-t1-boiler-hyena.lives: Dry industrial floors around boiler rooms, machinery, and maintenance corridors
industrial-t1-boiler-hyena.look: lean gray hyena with patchy fur, oversized jaws, and dark stains around its mouth
industrial-t1-boiler-hyena.name: boiler hyena
industrial-t1-boiler-hyena.special: Lets out a loud cackle that can alert nearby monsters

industrial-t1-boiler-scorpion.attack: stings the player with its tail
industrial-t1-boiler-scorpion.lives: Boiler rooms, warm machinery spaces, and dry industrial floors
industrial-t1-boiler-scorpion.look: large dark scorpion with heat-scarred armor, thick pincers, and a swollen tail
industrial-t1-boiler-scorpion.name: boiler scorpion
industrial-t1-boiler-scorpion.special: Poisoned sting briefly slows the player

industrial-t1-furnace-centipede.lives: Warm ventilation ducts, furnaces, and machinery spaces
industrial-t1-furnace-centipede.look: long reddish-brown centipede with dozens of thin legs and a dark armored head
industrial-t1-furnace-centipede.name: furnace centipede

industrial-t1-oil-slug.attack: covers the player in corrosive slime
industrial-t1-oil-slug.lives: Oil-stained floors, drainage channels, and dark machinery rooms
industrial-t1-oil-slug.look: large black slug with a glossy oily body and pale feelers
industrial-t1-oil-slug.name: oil slug
industrial-t1-oil-slug.special: Leaves a slippery trail behind itself

construction-t1-hammerhead-mole.lives: Unfinished floors, rubble piles, and areas beneath construction debris
construction-t1-hammerhead-mole.look: large blind mole with an oversized flattened skull, thick claws, and gray dusty fur
construction-t1-hammerhead-mole.name: hammerhead mole

construction-t1-rebar-tick.lives: Scaffolding, exposed rebar, and dark construction cavities
construction-t1-rebar-tick.look: oversized dark tick with thin rigid legs and a hard segmented body
construction-t1-rebar-tick.name: rebar tick
construction-t1-rebar-tick.special: Latches onto the player briefly, slowing movement

construction-t1-scaffold-goat.lives: Scaffolding, unfinished floors, and elevated construction platforms
construction-t1-scaffold-goat.look: thin feral goat with unusually long legs, oversized horns, and patchy gray fur
construction-t1-scaffold-goat.name: scaffold goat
construction-t1-scaffold-goat.special: Can cross narrow beams without slowing down

construction-t1-concrete-tortoise.lives: Rubble piles, concrete floors, and sheltered construction areas
construction-t1-concrete-tortoise.look: heavy tortoise with a cracked shell coated in concrete dust and gray mineral growth
construction-t1-concrete-tortoise.name: concrete tortoise

business-t1-window-cicada.lives: Office exteriors, ventilation openings, and illuminated windows
business-t1-window-cicada.look: large gray cicada with translucent wings and oversized red eyes
business-t1-window-cicada.name: window cicada
business-t1-window-cicada.special: Produces a loud buzzing sound that briefly disrupts nearby enemies

business-t1-suit-owl.lives: Office towers, rooftop ledges, and dark maintenance floors
business-t1-suit-owl.look: large dark owl with narrow black feather markings resembling a suit and unusually long talons
business-t1-suit-owl.name: suit owl
business-t1-suit-owl.special: Silent movement makes it difficult to detect before attacking

business-t1-glass-squirrel.lives: Window ledges, office planters, and rooftop gardens
business-t1-glass-squirrel.look: hairless gray squirrel with translucent patches of skin and oversized black eyes
business-t1-glass-squirrel.name: glass squirrel

business-t1-elevator-wasp.lives: Elevator shafts, mechanical rooms, and office ventilation systems
business-t1-elevator-wasp.look: large black and yellow wasp with an elongated abdomen and unusually long stinger
business-t1-elevator-wasp.name: elevator wasp
business-t1-elevator-wasp.special: Can attack from above and retreat quickly

residential-t1-attic-weasel.lives: Attics, wall cavities, insulation, and abandoned upper floors
residential-t1-attic-weasel.look: long thin weasel with pale fur, oversized teeth, and dark eyes
residential-t1-attic-weasel.name: attic weasel

residential-t1-mold-rabbit.lives: Abandoned apartments, roof gardens, and dry living spaces
residential-t1-mold-rabbit.look: large white rabbit with patchy fur and pale fungal growth around its ears and back
residential-t1-mold-rabbit.name: mold rabbit
residential-t1-mold-rabbit.special: Makes sudden long jumps when attacked

residential-t1-chimney-possum.lives: Chimneys, attics, and abandoned residential interiors
residential-t1-chimney-possum.look: large gray possum with swollen eyes, long claws, and a partially hairless tail
residential-t1-chimney-possum.name: chimney possum
residential-t1-chimney-possum.special: Plays dead briefly when severely injured

residential-t1-ceiling-mouse.lives: Ceiling cavities, walls, and abandoned apartments
residential-t1-ceiling-mouse.look: tiny pale mouse with oversized ears and long thin limbs
residential-t1-ceiling-mouse.name: ceiling mouse
residential-t1-ceiling-mouse.special: Very difficult to hit while moving through ceiling gaps

commercial-t1-butcher-dog.lives: Abandoned restaurants, food storage areas, and commercial kitchens
commercial-t1-butcher-dog.look: large feral dog with powerful shoulders, an enlarged jaw, and patchy dirty fur
commercial-t1-butcher-dog.name: butcher dog
commercial-t1-butcher-dog.special: Becomes more aggressive below half health

commercial-t1-freezer-cricket.lives: Cold storage areas, restaurant equipment rooms, and food warehouses
commercial-t1-freezer-cricket.look: large pale cricket with long antennae and an unusually thick abdomen
commercial-t1-freezer-cricket.name: freezer cricket

commercial-t1-shopping-crab.attack: snaps its claws at the player
commercial-t1-shopping-crab.lives: Abandoned shopping areas, food courts, and storage rooms
commercial-t1-shopping-crab.look: small red crab with oversized claws and a shell covered in scratches
commercial-t1-shopping-crab.name: shopping crab

commercial-t1-meat-fly.attack: lands on the player and bites
commercial-t1-meat-fly.lives: Food storage rooms, restaurants, garbage areas, and butcher shops
commercial-t1-meat-fly.look: oversized blue-black fly with a swollen abdomen and cloudy compound eyes
commercial-t1-meat-fly.name: meat fly
commercial-t1-meat-fly.special: Moves unpredictably and can quickly change direction

civil-t1-police-horse.lives: Police facilities, public courtyards, and abandoned civic buildings
civil-t1-police-horse.look: large thin horse with an unusually muscular neck, cloudy eyes, and patchy coat
civil-t1-police-horse.name: police horse
civil-t1-police-horse.special: Charges directly toward the player from a distance

civil-t1-archive-silverfish.lives: Archives, libraries, records rooms, and document storage
civil-t1-archive-silverfish.look: large silverfish with an elongated metallic body and long trailing bristles
civil-t1-archive-silverfish.name: archive silverfish
civil-t1-archive-silverfish.special: Can hide beneath loose papers and debris

civil-t1-firehouse-salamander.lives: Fire stations, equipment rooms, and damp utility areas
civil-t1-firehouse-salamander.look: large black salamander with bright red markings and unusually thick limbs
civil-t1-firehouse-salamander.name: firehouse salamander
civil-t1-firehouse-salamander.special: Produces a mildly irritating skin secretion

civil-t1-chapel-snail.lives: Churches, chapels, public monuments, and sheltered civic buildings
civil-t1-chapel-snail.look: large pale snail with a thick spiral shell covered in faint mineral deposits
civil-t1-chapel-snail.name: chapel snail
civil-t1-chapel-snail.special: Leaves a sticky trail that slows movement

open-water-t1-drain-eel.lives: Newly flooded drains, pipes, and shallow water channels
open-water-t1-drain-eel.look: thin dark eel with pale eyes and a long flexible body
open-water-t1-drain-eel.name: drain eel

open-water-t1-water-strider.lives: Shallow flooded floors and pools of standing water
open-water-t1-water-strider.look: oversized dark water strider with extremely long thin legs
open-water-t1-water-strider.name: water strider
open-water-t1-water-strider.special: Moves rapidly across the surface of water

open-water-t1-minnow-school.lives: Shallow flooded rooms, pools, and submerged corridors
open-water-t1-minnow-school.look: dense school of small silver fish with oversized mouths and dark swollen eyes
open-water-t1-minnow-school.name: minnow school
open-water-t1-minnow-school.notes: Represents a school of fish rather than a single animal
open-water-t1-minnow-school.special: Moves as a group and surrounds nearby targets

open-water-t1-mudskipper.lives: Shallow flooded floors, muddy debris, and waterlogged rooms
open-water-t1-mudskipper.look: large brown mudskipper with oversized eyes, thick fins, and muscular front fins
open-water-t1-mudskipper.name: mudskipper
open-water-t1-mudskipper.special: Can move between water and dry surfaces
